our_interpretation: The scored forecast is the projected minimum of $7 million in realized spending during calendar 2026.
The context indicates spending on AI services and tokens, including Cursor, Anthropic and AWS Bedrock, rather than all staff or infrastructure costs associated with AI.
Might hit $10 million is a possible higher outcome, not a firm ceiling or a second required threshold.
At its current pace qualifies the tentative $10 million scenario. It is a projection assumption, not a separately observable antecedent to the $7 million minimum.
The profit comparison concerns the possible $10 million amount and is historical context rather than evidence that the spending forecast occurred.
The spending basis is estimate because the projection comes from reported internal spending figures rather than a stated accounting-standard expense measure.
criteria.support_condition: Comparable records establish at least $7 million of realized Zillow AI-service and token spending during calendar 2026.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Complete comparable calendar-2026 records establish realized spending below $7 million. Spending below $10 million alone does not contradict the forecast.
